description.en: Tall, tender pancakes with crisp buttery edges. A Sunday morning classic.
description.sr: Visoke, mekane američke palačinke sa hrskavim ivicama od putera. Klasik za nedeljno jutro.

en: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
Melt the butter. In another bowl whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ones and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes while a non-stick pan heats over medium heat.
Ladle 1/4 cup of batter per pancake. Flip when bubbles form on top, then cook 1 more minute.
Serve warm with maple syrup and berries.
sr: U velikoj činiji umutite brašno, šećer, prašak za pecivo, sodu bikarbonu i so.
Otopite puter. U drugoj činiji umutite mlaćenicu, jaja i otopljeni puter.
Sipajte tečne sastojke u suve i mešajte samo dok se ne sjedine. Nekoliko grudvica je u redu.
Ostavite smesu da odstoji 5 minuta dok se tiganj bez lepljenja zagreva na srednjoj vatri.
Sipajte 1/4 šolje smese po palačinki. Okrenite kada se na vrhu pojave mehurići, pa pecite još minut.
Služite toplo sa javorovim sirupom i bobičastim voćem.

description.en: Blistered Neapolitan-style crust with tomato, mozzarella and fresh basil.
description.sr: Napolitanska kora sa mehurićima, paradajzom, mocarelom i svežim bosiljkom.

en: Mix the flour, water, yeast and salt into a shaggy dough. Knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
Heat the oven to its maximum temperature with a baking tray or stone inside.
Crush the tomatoes with a pinch of salt and a splash of olive oil.
Stretch the dough thin, spread the tomato and tear the mozzarella over it.
Bake for 8–10 minutes until the crust is blistered. Finish with basil and olive oil.
sr: Pomešajte brašno, vodu, kvasac i so u grubo testo. Mesite 8 minuta dok ne postane glatko.
Pokrijte i ostavite da naraste 1 sat, dok ne udvostruči zapreminu.
Zagrejte rernu na najjaču temperaturu sa limom ili kamenom za picu unutra.
Izgnječite paradajz sa prstohvatom soli i malo maslinovog ulja.
Tanko razvucite testo, premažite paradajzom i preko rasporedite iscepkanu mocarelu.
Pecite 8–10 minuta dok kora ne dobije mehuriće. Završite bosiljkom i maslinovim uljem.

description.en: Horiatiki: chunky vegetables, a slab of feta and plenty of good olive oil.
description.sr: Horijatiki: krupno sečeno povrće, komad fete i dosta dobrog maslinovog ulja.

en: Cut the tomatoes into wedges and the cucumber into thick half-moons.
Slice the onion and pepper into thin rings.
Combine the vegetables and olives in a wide bowl and season with salt.
Lay the feta on top, drizzle generously with olive oil and sprinkle with oregano.
sr: Isecite paradajz na kriške, a krastavac na deblje polukrugove.
Luk i papriku isecite na tanke kolutove.
Pomešajte povrće i masline u širokoj činiji i posolite.
Položite fetu odozgo, obilno prelijte maslinovim uljem i pospite origanom.

description.en: Charred, yogurt-marinated chicken in a creamy spiced tomato sauce.
description.sr: Zapečena piletina marinirana u jogurtu, u kremastom začinjenom sosu od paradajza.

en: Mix the yogurt with half the garam masala, half the garlic and ginger, and the salt. Coat the chicken and marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken pieces until charred at the edges.
Melt the butter and soften the chopped onion with the remaining garlic, ginger and garam masala.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream and the chicken. Simmer for 10 minutes more.
Serve with rice or naan.
sr: Pomešajte jogurt sa polovinom garam masale, polovinom belog luka i đumbira, i solju. Uvaljajte piletinu i marinirajte najmanje 20 minuta.
Ispecite komade piletine na roštilju ili u tiganju dok ivice ne pocrne.
Otopite puter i propržite seckani crni luk sa ostatkom belog luka, đumbira i garam masale.
Dodajte paradajz i krčkajte 15 minuta, pa izblendajte u glatki sos.
Umešajte pavlaku i piletinu. Krčkajte još 10 minuta.
Služite sa pirinčem ili naan hlebom.

description.en: Meltingly tender beef and root vegetables in a rich, thyme-scented gravy.
description.sr: Junetina koja se topi u ustima i korenasto povrće u gustom sosu sa majčinom dušicom.

en: Toss the beef in seasoned flour and brown it in batches in the olive oil. Set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the same pot, then stir in the tomato paste.
Return the beef, pour in the stock and add the thyme. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 2 hours.
Add the carrots and potatoes in large chunks and cook 1 hour more, until everything is tender.
sr: Uvaljajte junetinu u začinjeno brašno i u delovima je zapecite na maslinovom ulju. Ostavite sa strane.
U istom loncu propržite crni i beli luk, pa umešajte paradajz pire.
Vratite junetinu, nalijte temeljac i dodajte majčinu dušicu. Pustite da lagano proključa.
Poklopite i kuvajte na najslabijoj vatri 2 sata.
Dodajte krupno sečenu šargarepu i krompir i kuvajte još sat vremena, dok sve ne omekša.

description.en: Crisp vegetables tossed in a glossy garlic-ginger sauce. On the table in 25 minutes.
description.sr: Hrskavo povrće u sjajnom sosu od belog luka i đumbira. Na stolu za 25 minuta.

en: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Cut the broccoli into florets and slice the pepper and carrots thinly.
Heat a wok until smoking, add the sesame oil, then the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the vegetables and stir-fry on high heat for 4–5 minutes.
Splash in the soy sauce, toss to coat and serve over the rice.
sr: Skuvajte pirinač prema uputstvu na pakovanju.
Brokoli podelite na cvetiće, a papriku i šargarepu tanko isecite.
Zagrejte vok dok ne počne da se dimi, dodajte susamovo ulje, pa beli luk i đumbir na 30 sekundi.
Dodajte povrće i pržite na jakoj vatri 4–5 minuta uz stalno mešanje.
Dodajte soja sos, promešajte i služite preko pirinča.

description.en: Crisp edges, chewy centres and puddles of melted chocolate.
description.sr: Hrskave ivice, žvakava sredina i barice otopljene čokolade.

en: Heat the oven to 180 °C and line two trays with baking paper.
Cream the soft butter with both sugars until fluffy. Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop balls of dough onto the trays, leaving room to spread.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes.
sr: Zagrejte rernu na 180 °C i obložite dva pleha papirom za pečenje.
Umutite omekšali puter sa obe vrste šećera dok ne postane penast. Umutite jaja i vanilu.
Umešajte brašno, sodu bikarbonu i so, pa čokoladne kapi.
Kašikom ređajte kuglice testa na plehove, sa dovoljno razmaka.
Pecite 10–12 minuta dok ivice ne porumene, a sredina ostane meka. Ostavite 5 minuta da se ohlade na plehu.

description.en: Silky salmon steamed with ginger and scallions, finished with sizzling oil.
description.sr: Svilenkasti losos kuvan na pari sa đumbirom i mladim lukom, preliven vrelim uljem.

en: Cut the ginger and scallions into fine matchsticks.
Place the salmon on a heatproof plate and scatter half the ginger over it.
Steam over boiling water for 8–10 minutes until just opaque.
Pour the soy sauce over the fish and top with the remaining ginger and the scallions.
Heat the sesame oil with the sliced garlic until sizzling and pour it over the fish. Serve with rice.
sr: Isecite đumbir i mladi luk na tanke štapiće.
Stavite losos na tanjir otporan na toplotu i pospite polovinom đumbira.
Kuvajte na pari iznad kipuće vode 8–10 minuta, dok riba tek ne postane neprozirna.
Prelijte ribu soja sosom i pospite ostatkom đumbira i mladim lukom.
Zagrejte susamovo ulje sa isečenim belim lukom dok ne zacvrči i prelijte preko ribe. Služite sa pirinčem.

description.en: Squeaky, golden halloumi and summer vegetables with lemon and oregano.
description.sr: Zlatni halumi sir i letnje povrće sa limunom i origanom.

en: Cut the halloumi and vegetables into bite-sized chunks and thread them onto skewers.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice and oregano, then brush it over the skewers.
Grill over high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until charred.
Squeeze over more lemon before serving.
sr: Isecite halumi i povrće na komade veličine zalogaja i nanižite ih na štapiće.
Umutite maslinovo ulje, limunov sok i origano i premažite ražnjiće.
Pecite na jakoj vatri 3–4 minuta sa svake strane dok ne dobiju tragove roštilja.
Pre služenja pokapajte još limunovog soka.

description.en: Velvety soup made with oven-roasted tomatoes and garlic, finished with basil.
description.sr: Somotasta supa od paradajza i belog luka pečenih u rerni, sa bosiljkom.

en: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Halve the tomatoes, quarter the onion and halve the garlic head across.
Toss everything with the olive oil and salt and roast for 35 minutes.
Squeeze the garlic out of its skins into a pot with the tomatoes, onion and stock.
Simmer for 10 minutes, add the basil and blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream and adjust the seasoning.
sr: Zagrejte rernu na 200 °C. Prepolovite paradajz, isecite crni luk na četvrtine i prepolovite glavicu belog luka.
Sve pomešajte sa maslinovim uljem i solju i pecite 35 minuta.
Istisnite beli luk iz ljuski u lonac sa paradajzom, crnim lukom i temeljcem.
Krčkajte 10 minuta, dodajte bosiljak i izblendajte u glatku supu.
Umešajte pavlaku i doterajte začine.
